data.body: S2d change 1976 PS1 gates: LLM-Review+1 PASS (6 advisory); Verified-1 — sole CI failure was tests/interfaces/contracts/test_bridge_vocabulary_stale_heldout.py (gen_cli_help.py:42 names bridge-fsck/-probe in _OVERVIEW_OMIT, uncategorized). Full suite 1 failed/14983 passed → local hang was host bare-repo quirk only. Fixes (PS2, amended 6968ac9a5f): (1) categorized scripts/gen_cli_help.py in the guard's _COMPATIBILITY_FILES (mirrors gen_cli_reference.py); (2) real correctness bug from LLM advisory — _NESTED_FAMILY derived from group=='bridge' wrongly swept in flat bridge-fsck, so a non-leading --help fell through to argparse (lowercase usage:, wrong prog) instead of the pinned artifact; re-derived from bridge's parser_factory (RED-first test in test_create_help_no_write_b8de.py); (3) advisory coverage: blank-summary guard teeth test + config-prefix help routing test. Re-validated: held-out 13/13, happy 8/8, b8de 8/8, vocab guard 7/7, lint+typecheck+complexity clean. Pushed PS2; both votes auto-removed, re-running.
